payload.selection_rationale: Composed by the engine from 2 minor defects a failing test proves (SC-040, SC-047). Each names the defect and carries the test that shows it, so there was nothing for a tournament to choose between.

key_decisions.decision: SC-040: IN-m1 (minor): The rule 'no Go file names a forwarded header other than X-Forwarded-For' is quiet, in both quote styles, on three client-identity header names: "X-Forwarded", "Cf-Pseudo-IPv4" and "CF-Connecting-IPv6".
key_decisions.rationale: the engine watched internal/fitnessrules/forwarded_fence_names_test.go fail with `go test -count=1 -run ^TestForwardedFenceCatchesBareAndVersionedNames$ ./internal/fitnessrules`

key_decisions.decision: SC-047: IN-m2 (minor): Two of the browser rules this slice added miss three spellings.
key_decisions.rationale: the engine watched internal/fitnessrules/sl015_rule_probe_test.go fail with `go test -count=1 -run TestSL015BrowserRulesSeeFlagsInsideALongerStringAndCmdEnviron ./internal/fitnessrules`

payload.coherence_check: Each row is fixed on its own and none may undo another. A row whose test already passes is left alone, and the build says so.
